judged_text: The retained test 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' no longer exercises any host-related condition: the implementation silently dropped the hosts-configured precondition from expandable_first_post?, and the test now passes only because embed_truncate defaults to false and has_topic_embed? is false on an unsaved topic. A semantic change (first-post expansion no longer requires any configured embeddable host, altering behavior for sites with embed_truncate enabled but zero hosts) ships without an explicit acceptance decision, and the misleadingly-named test provides false coverage — it would still pass if the method regressed or if the embed_truncate default ever flipped.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `Topic#expandable_first_post?` from `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? && SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` to `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` (app/models/topic.rb), so the “hosts configured” precondition is indeed dropped without replacement (e.g., no `EmbeddableHost` presence check). In the corresponding spec, the test still named `"is false if embeddable_host is blank"` no longer sets any host-related state and will pass due to unrelated defaults (`embed_truncate` not enabled and/or `has_topic_embed?` false on a built topic), making it misleading/false coverage (spec/models/topic_spec.rb). This is a concrete test/intent clarity issue grounded in the diff; whether the behavior change is a product bug cannot be conclusively determined from the diff alone.
